helping you move forward.

Iconic Overseas Services is a manpower and overseas placement consultancy based in Parsudih, Jamshedpur. Our team helps candidates understand recruitment opportunities and the steps involved in applying for work abroad.

Bring your questions, experience and career goals. We’ll help you understand which openings may fit and what to ask before you take the next step.
